claims.evidence: 18 physical cultures: 3 conditions (mock, MNV(UVi), MNV) x 2 harvest times x 3 independent replicates ("Three independent replicates were made"). Each source name is one SILAC-labelled dish, mixed 1:1:1 with the other two conditions of the same replicate and time; each mix is one MaxQuant Experiment (6 h: 4/5/6 = Exp1/2/3; 10 h: 1/2/3).
Numbered 1..3 within each (infection x sampling time) group; replicate n = file prefix Expn = the n-th independent replicate. Each number denotes one independent culture.

claims.value: SILAC light / SILAC medium / SILAC heavy
claims.evidence: summary.txt Multiplicity 3, Labels0 empty (light), Labels1 Arg6;Lys4 (medium), Labels2 Arg10;Lys8 (heavy) for all 60 raw files (rule 14 verified). Paper: light (R0K0), medium (R6K4), heavy (R10K8); cells labelled for 5 passages (full, not pulsed, SILAC).

claims.value: uninfected / UV-inactivated Murine norovirus 1 / Murine norovirus 1
claims.evidence: Channel map (identical at 6 h and 10 h): Exp1 L=mock, M=MNV(UVi), H=MNV; Exp2 L=MNV, M=mock, H=MNV(UVi); Exp3 L=MNV(UVi), M=MNV, H=mock. (1) MNV channel = the channel holding the nascent viral proteins: VP1 intensity 6 h Exp1 L/M/H 0.25e9/0.03e9/2.80e9, Exp2 0.90e9/0.02e9/0.03e9, Exp3 0.31e9/2.41e9/0.06e9; same pattern at 10 h. (2) Methods: "Three independent replicates were made with a different SILAC medium assigned to a given condition for each replicate" -> Latin square; Fig. 6A draws Light/Medium/Heavy over mock/MNV(UVi)/MNV, matching Exp1. (3) Of the 8 possible mock/UVi assignments, only this one reproduces the published coordinates: 6 h mean log2 MNV/mock vs MNV/UVi VP1 5.20/7.61, NS3 3.88/4.21, NS1-2 3.88/3.34, NS5 2.93/3.37 = Fig. S7 (measured 5.2/7.6, 3.88/4.23, 3.88/3.35, 2.93/3.38); 10 h NS3 4.22/7.35, NS7 3.82/7.03, VP1 4.70/6.81, VP2 5.58/4.48, VF1 4.25/4.58, NS4 3.36/3.49 = Fig. 6B (4.25/7.32, 3.85/6.99, 4.74/6.75, 5.63/4.45, 4.29/4.55, 3.38/3.48). The swapped mock/UVi assignment gives mirrored values (e.g. 6 h VP1 7.61/5.20). Pathogen: MNV-1 strain CW1 = NCBITaxon:223997 Murine norovirus 1; mock rows "uninfected" (mock-infected).
"Mock-, MNV(UVi) or MNV-infected at MOI=10 TCID50/cell". Custom column (spec Extending Templates).

limitations: No per-replicate channel table is published; the mock/MNV(UVi) channel identities are derived from the Methods Latin-square statement plus Fig. 6A, and confirmed by reproducing the published Fig. 6B / Fig. S7 viral-protein coordinates from the deposited proteinGroups.txt (only 1 of 8 assignments matches). The MNV channel is directly evidenced by viral-protein intensities.
Figure coordinates were read from rendered images (Fig. S7 PDF at 400 dpi; Fig. 6 PMC JPEG 701 px wide), precision ~0.05 log2 units.
The 6 h results archive has no parameters.txt; its fixed Carbamidomethyl is inferred from peptides.txt masses, its tolerances from the paper.
Met->Triazole-PEG4-biotin (+452.238 Da) has no Unimod accession; it is written with MM= and no AC, so parse_sdrf convert-openms refuses the file (only Unimod modifications supported).
Sampling time uses the harvest time (6.5 / 10.5 h, PRIDE description); the paper labels the arms 6 h / 10 h p.i. (AHA window 6-6.5 h and 10-10.5 h).
Reduction and alkylation reagents are not stated (not available).
PRIDE instrument "Orbitrap Fusion Lumos" contradicts raw headers and paper (Orbitrap Fusion); the raw value is used.

No sample sheet is deposited; the Exp1-3 file prefixes (= MaxQuant Experiments) are the only replicate identifiers, and whether replicate n at 6 h and at 10 h came from the same experiment day is not stated (they are separate dishes either way).
